text:
Tess: Quick sprint thread — we need a short, tight copy pass for three landing pages: Hosted API, Redwood Dedicated, and Private (VPC & on-prem). Requirements: one-line hero, one-line benchmark hint, webinar CTA (unique), and a routing + lead-scoring payload for registrants. Can we lock by EOD?
Marco: I can do benchmarks. Will post p50/p95 snippets and a one-line bench blurb we can show under the hero.
Li: I’ll post 3 hero options per mode and 3 CTA variants. Trying to keep them punchy and developer-forward.
Pri: Compliance note: use exact product labels "Private (VPC & on-prem)" and the term "customer-managed keys (CMK)". Replace "audit logs" with "audit trail". Avoid the word "pricing" on public pages.
OpsBot: Meeting created: https://calendar.example/event/5201112222  reminder set 1h.
Tess: Routing rules: please include fields company_size, annual_revenue, deployment_interest, role. Lead scoring rule we want for initial routing: if annual_revenue >= 5000000 OR company_size >= 500 -> sales-qualified; else marketing-nurture. Also: if deployment_interest=="Private" AND role in ("Security","Infra") -> route to enterprise-security SDR with priority=true.
Marco: Bench suggestions (short): Hosted: "p50 90ms, p95 140ms (chat, 8k)"; Dedicated: "sustained 20-28k tokens/min per pool"; Private: "identical runtime, behind your network". I’ll attach lab links after runs.
Li: Hero drafts (unique phrasing):

Hosted H-A: "Hosted API — ship LLM features without managing infra"
Hosted H-B: "Hosted API — production-ready inference, API-first"
Hosted H-C: "Hosted API — fast responses for interactive apps"

Dedicated D-A: "Redwood Dedicated — reserved GPU lanes for predictable throughput"
Dedicated D-B: "Redwood Dedicated — commit capacity, enforce SLAs"
Dedicated D-C: "Redwood Dedicated — pin models, retain performance"

Private P-A: "Private (VPC & on-prem) — run our runtime inside your perimeter"
Private P-B: "Private (VPC & on-prem) — CMK, audit trail, and on-prem options"
Private P-C: "Private (VPC & on-prem) — inference where your data lives"

Li: CTA options (avoid previously overused phrasing):
1) "Claim your spot  live demo & benchmarks"
2) "Register: live run + office hours"
3) "Join demo: performance, rollout, controls"
Microline under CTA idea: "Benchmarks measured on production-like workloads  live Q&A included"

Pri: Small legal tweak: replace "live run" with "live demo" in CTA 2 for clarity. Also prefer the phrase "unit economics" over "pricing" if we need to reference cost.
Tess: Good. CRM/form wiring: can you paste a sample webhook payload so forms/dev can wire and we can include fields for scoring?
CRMBot: Sample webhook payload (please wire these exact fields):

```
{
  "email": "lead@example.com",
  "full_name": "Alex Lead",
  "company": "Example Co",
  "company_size": 1200,
  "annual_revenue": 7500000,
  "role": "Infra",
  "deployment_interest": "Private",
  "utm_campaign": "launch-q3-2026"
}
```

CRMBot: Mapping notes: map deployment_interest -> contact.tags (hosted,dedicated,private); compute size_bucket from company_size; set score >= 1 (sales-qualified) if annual_revenue >= 5000000 OR company_size >= 500; set priority=true for Private + role in (Security, Infra).
Marco: I’ll provide the bench doc links after the 9:30 run and will recommend the exact p95 string for Hosted to use in the microline.
Li: My pick for final hero set: Hosted H-B, Dedicated D-A, Private P-B. CTA: option 1 "Claim your spot  live demo & benchmarks" with microline. Short trust line under hero: "Benchmarks on production-like workloads" linking to the bench doc.
Pri: Legal approves the P-B phrasing (CMK + audit trail). Also ok with the CTA and microline as long as we don’t promise pricing details.
Tess: Action list: Li finalize copy into staging; Marco to drop bench links and canonical p95/p50; Ops to open GH routing issue with the webhook sample and mapping; Forms to wire the webhook and tag leads. Confirmers for 3pm review: @Marco @Li @OpsBot.
CRMBot: Form endpoint created: https://forms.example/launch-q3-2026  fields mapped as above.
Li: I’ll upload the staged hero mock to #design and post copy snippets by 1:30.
Marco: Will attach bench artifacts and a short benchmark blurb by 12:15.
Tess: Thanks team  if we lock this today we can enable the hero CTA for the launch email tomorrow. :rocket:
Pri: Approved.
OpsBot: GH issue opened: https://github.com/redwood/infra/issues/1832  tagging eng-forms.
Tess: Great work all  wrapping up.
